audience: businesses that send invoices from Billutant

useCases.title: Find invoices that were never sent
useCases.text: List the invoices with their sent state. Open one for its number, status and files.

useCases.title: Create a draft invoice from standard items
useCases.text: List the customers and items. Then create a draft invoice from their ids. A draft is saved, and nothing is sent.

useCases.title: Send an invoice with a template
useCases.text: List the e-mail templates. Then send an issued invoice to its customer. Sending cannot be undone.

useCases.title: Find customers without an e-mail address
useCases.text: List the customers. Read each customer for its contact details.
